summary: DNS of the cylinder wake at Re = 100 to t = 200. The vortex street develops from a restart file.
description: Cylinder Re=100 DNS to t = 200. Regression values of this repository, not literature values. The run is deterministic: Jean Zay (ifort, 8 ranks), a workstation with gfortran (four optimisation levels, floating-point traps, signalling NaN) and ifx (three levels) agree to 5e-11 in the field norms and to all printed digits in the Strouhal number.

strouhal.note: Peak of an FFT of vy at the first probe over the last 70 time units, so the resolution is 1/70 = 0.014 and the value is limited by the FFT bin. The DMD stage 610_modal_dmd gives 0.1657 for the same flow.

last_snapshot_time.note: The run reaches endTime = 200 and writes 20 snapshots.

snapshot_vx_norm.note: Norm of vx in the last snapshot.

snapshot_vy_norm.note: Norm of vy in the last snapshot.

snapshot_vy_max.note: Largest vy in the last snapshot.
